text:
Before the meal: two slices of toast (about 30 g each, roughly 75 kcal each), two strawberry jam portions (about 14 g each, roughly 35 kcal each), and a cup of black coffee, which is close to 0 kcal.

After the meal: the toast is gone apart from a few crumbs, and both jam containers are empty. The packets look scraped, with possibly a little jam left. The coffee mug appears empty.

Toast: 2 × 75 = 150 kcal, 60 g.
Jam: 2 × 35 = 70 kcal, 28 g. If a little remained, about 90% was eaten, so roughly 63 kcal and 25 g.
Coffee: about 200 g of liquid at roughly 2 kcal. It is a drink, so I am leaving its mass out of the food total.

Total: about 150 + 63 = 213 kcal, and about 60 + 25 = 85 g of food.
